items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: So, uh, I worked with Charlie Cook.

ctx.x: Oh yes, was Freddy Kepard with you at the, with Cook's band at that time? No, I, uh, no. Or did you take his place? No, I've taken his place. Uh, Freddy was with him.

Uh, at the White, at White City. Yeah. And he, uh, he was with him over to Dreamland too. He, he came in after I did. He'd take my place over to Dreamland. Yeah. And I'd take his place at, uh, White City. Uh huh. So, uh, I worked with Charlie Cook. Charlie Cook. Charlie Cook. I think Charlie, I heard, he, he passed here. Yes, not long ago. Oh, six months or last fall. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Uh huh. Yeah, I worked with, uh, worked with, with him quite a while. I was going to ask about Freddy Kepard, how he compared…
I guess everybody does. You had a style of your own too.
